title: Standard Gaussian polar radial mass
statement: For each natural number $n$, define the standard Gaussian polar radial mass to be the integral of the standard Gaussian polar radial density over positive radii: $\int_{r>0} \text{standard Gaussian polar radial density in dimension }n\,dr$, interpreted as a nonnegative extended real number.
caveat: The density’s definition is not included in the supplied statement, so its dependence on dimension cannot be verified.
